end.summary:
Practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read food chains using arrows.
Correctly made several chains, including grass → deer and algae → larvae → fish.
Predicted effects of removing organisms from a food chain.

end.parentNote: Manav practised grouping animals by what they eat and reading food chains with arrows. They explained that an arrow should point from the leaf to the caterpillar because the caterpillar eats the leaf, and they correctly built several chains. They mixed up how plants get food, saying plants would not get food if dead leaves were removed; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Manav to draw one food chain and explain what changes if one part is removed.
